verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships AI features (First Pass AI, GenAI DDQ, AI Helpbot), so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, no evidence documents an opt-out, a no-training guarantee, or a data-use control for model training. The Helpbot transparency article only says answers draw on approved support content. The MCP 'limits you set' refers to agent permissions, an adjacent control that earns no credit here.
